findings.current: At Jangcheon’s faint smile, Jeok Cheongang found himself unable to speak. He felt neither anger nor betrayal. Something merely welled up from deep within his heart and left him numb.
findings.defect: The draft renders 먹먹해졌다 as emotional numbness, but it describes Jeok Cheongang becoming choked up or overwhelmed as something rises within him.
findings.rationale: The source emphasizes an emotion rising until he is too choked up to speak, not an absence or deadening of feeling.
findings.replacement: At Jangcheon’s faint smile, Jeok Cheongang found himself unable to speak. He felt neither anger nor betrayal. Something simply welled up from deep within him and left him choked up.
findings.source: 빙긋 웃는 장천의 모습에 적천강은 말문이 막혔다. 분노도, 배신감도 들지 않았다. 그저 마음 깊숙한 곳에서 뭔가가 치밀어 올라 먹먹해졌다.

findings.current: The fact that the Azure Sky Sword King had come in person meant that every suspicion and piece of evidence had already been assembled. But that alone was not enough.
findings.defect: “Every suspicion and piece of evidence” obscures the explicit evidentiary distinction between 심증 and 물증.
findings.rationale: 심증과 물증 distinguishes the circumstantial case from material or physical evidence rather than referring to suspicions generically.
findings.replacement: The fact that the Azure Sky Sword King had come in person meant that all the circumstantial and physical evidence was already in hand. But that alone was not enough.
findings.source: 창천검왕이 직접 찾아왔다는 것은 이미 모든 심증과 물증이 갖춰져 있다는 뜻이었지만, 그것으로는 부족했다.

findings.current: Maybe the Nangong Family and the Azure Sky Sword King had simply identified the wrong person.
findings.defect: The draft turns a mistaken judgment of Jangcheon’s character into a mistaken identification of the culprit.
findings.rationale: 사람을 잘못 보다 here means to judge someone incorrectly; the following exchange confirms that Jeok Cheongang, not the Nangong Family, was the one who had misjudged Jangcheon.
findings.replacement: Maybe the Nangong Family and the Azure Sky Sword King had simply misjudged him.
findings.source: 문득 그런 생각이 들더군. 뭔가 착오가 있었던 것이 아닐까, 어쩌면 남궁세가와 창천검왕이 사람을 잘못 본 것이 아닐까 하는.

findings.current: I think you may have mistaken the person, Sir Jeok.
findings.defect: The wording repeats the mistaken-identity error and loses Taekyung’s pointed reversal of Jeok Cheongang’s claim.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is saying that Jeok Cheongang misjudged Jangcheon’s nature, creating a direct ironic echo of the preceding line.
findings.replacement: I think you’re the one who misjudged him, Sir Jeok.
findings.source: 제 생각엔 적 대협께서 사람을 잘못 보신 것 같은데요.

findings.current: Jeok Cheongang silently lifted the bottle of liquor to his lips.
findings.defect: The draft omits the completed action of drinking directly and heavily from the bottle.
findings.rationale: 병째로 들이켰다 means he gulped the liquor directly from the bottle, not merely that he raised it to his lips.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang silently tipped back the bottle and drank straight from it.

findings.current: The timing was perfect. You were busy training, so you left me alone, and thanks to that, I could run wild.
findings.defect: “Left me alone” softens 방관하셨고, losing Jangcheon’s accusation that his Master neglected him or stood by without paying attention.
findings.rationale: 방관 carries blame for neglect or passive disregard, while 마음껏 explicitly emphasizes that Jangcheon acted as freely as he pleased.
findings.replacement: The timing was perfect. You happened to be so absorbed in your training that you neglected me, and thanks to that, I could run wild to my heart’s content.
findings.source: 시기가 좋았습니다. 때마침 사부님께서는 수련에 힘쓰시느라 저를 방관하셨고, 덕분에 마음껏 활개 칠 수 있었으니까요.

findings.current: No matter how much liquor I drank at the pleasure house or how many women I embraced, I couldn’t get rid of that feeling.
findings.defect: The draft adds an unspecified multiplicity of women that is absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 여인을 안아도 refers generically to embracing a woman, while 술을 진탕 마시고 supplies the excess associated with drinking.
findings.replacement: Even after drinking myself senseless at a pleasure house and embracing a woman, I couldn’t get rid of that feeling.
findings.source: 기루에서 술을 진탕 마시고 여인을 안아도 그 느낌을 지울 수 없었습니다.

findings.defect: Jangcheon incorrectly refers to his Master’s Sinews and Meridians rather than his own, reversing the target of the threatened punishment.
findings.rationale: Jeok Cheongang has just threatened to sever Jangcheon’s 근맥, and Jangcheon repeats the threatened punishment before asking what comes next.

findings.current: “Then why haven’t you killed me yet?
findings.defect: The draft loses both the immediacy of 당장 and the forceful physical register of 쳐 죽이다.
findings.rationale: Jangcheon is provocatively demanding to know why Jeok Cheongang does not kill him on the spot, using deliberately forceful language.
findings.replacement: “Then why don’t you strike me dead right now?
findings.source: ‘한데 왜 저를 당장 쳐 죽이지 않으십니까?

findings.current: “That bow I just gave you… was my final farewell. I’ll leave by this road. I’ll go far away and never return.”
findings.defect: “Leave by this road” is a literal Korean-syntax calque; 이 길로 here means that he will leave immediately or directly from there.
findings.rationale: The source announces Jangcheon’s immediate departure rather than identifying a literal road or route.
findings.replacement: “That bow I just gave you… was my final farewell. I’m leaving now. I’ll go far away and never return.”
findings.source: ‘방금 드린 절은…… 제 마지막 인사입니다. 저는 이 길로 떠나겠습니다. 멀리 떠나서 다시 돌아오지 않겠습니다.’

summary: One critical subject reversal and several meaningful losses of mechanism, characterization, intimacy, and register.
